summary: @dajbelshaw With a nod to @timelineJS so it's extra cool. Great tutorial on intros to Google APIs, I have always wanted to play and try to see if we could make an add-on to Google Slides that integrates @cogdog Flickr CC attributor to automatically add an image credit slide.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @dajbelshaw With a nod to @timelineJS so it's extra cool. Great tutorial on intros to Google APIs, I have always wanted to play and try to see if we could make an add-on to Google Slides that integrates @cogdog Flickr CC attributor to automatically add an image credit slide.
